mapper.sql: id, group_id, name, anniversary_date, is_recurring, remind_days, description, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO anniversary (group_id, name, anniversary_date, is_recurring, remind_days, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{name}, #{anniversaryDate}, #{isRecurring}, #{remindDays}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM anniversary WHERE id = #{id} AND group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE anniversary SET name = #{name}, anniversary_date = #{anniversaryDate}, is_recurring = #{isRecurring}, remind_days = #{remindDays}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM anniversary WHERE is_recurring = 1 AND remind_days > 0 AND DATEDIFF( anniversary_date, CURDATE() ) = #{days}
SELECT FROM anniversary ORDER BY anniversary_date ASC
